violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment which has only non-TCS foods and/or minimally prepares or handles Ready-to-Eat (RTE) food unless it is under the immediate control of a limited certified food manager. CFM certification was expired at time of visit.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a limited certified food managers certificate.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. Food thermometers in establishment observed with dead batteries.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Please obtain new thermometer or new batteries.
